> Marcus (finance) — would you confirm the standard amortization approach Redwood uses for prepaid multi-year deals and whether we can provide Year-by-Year invoice stubs that call out period-of-service dates?

Hi all — quick finance input:

1) Invoice cadence: yes, we can issue three invoice documents that total the committed prepay for the 36-month term. We will create each invoice with a clear invoice date and specify the service coverage window in the invoice description (e.g., Invoice 1 covers 2026-07-01 through 2027-06-30).

2) Revenue recognition approach: Redwood recognizes revenue over the service period on a straight-line basis unless specific milestones are tied to delivery. For multi-year prepay we produce an amortization schedule that allocates the prepay amount to monthly recognized revenue across the coverage window.

3) Accounting/ledger mechanics: For our internal GL entries we post the cash receipt to Deferred Revenue and then amortize monthly to Revenue. For your internal budgeting you can treat each invoice as a payment in that fiscal year; deferred expense treatment is a procurement/accounting judgment on your side — we'll provide the supporting schedule and narrative.

4) Requested deliverables: I'll generate: (a) a suggested amortization table (monthly rows, USD amounts), (b) three invoice stubs with invoice numbers and coverage windows, and (c) a short note describing the recognition policy for your accounting team. Expect these in 1 business day.
